mapper.select: SELECT forecast.forecast_id, (SELECT snapshot.snapshot_id FROM asset_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.user_id = forecast.user_id ORDER BY snapshot.snapshot_date DESC, snapshot.snapshot_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS snapshot_id, forecast.expected_asset, forecast.financial_discharge_date, forecast.achievement_rate, forecast.monthly_spending_limit, goal.target_amount, profile.discharge_date AS actual_discharge_date FROM cashflow_forecast forecast INNER JOIN goal ON goal.user_id = forecast.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN soldier_profile profile ON profile.user_id = forecast.user_id WHERE forecast.forecast_id = (SELECT latest.forecast_id FROM cashflow_forecast latest WHERE latest.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY latest.generated_at DESC, latest.forecast_id DESC LIMIT 1)
